name: Sour Lime Haze | Ice Packs Rosin, Diamond, Hash Infused | 5pk
description:
Rove Ice Packs, the world’s first triple-infused preroll. Made with premium-grade flower fully-infused with THCA diamonds and solventless ice hash rosin, they're expertly rolled, then coated with more ice hash. Super smooth and ultra potent, Rove Ice Packs test at over 50% THC. Welcome to the next evolution of prerolls.

SOUR LIME HAZE - SATIVA 
A zesty sativa-forward strain bursting with sharp citrus and herbal spice, Sour Lime Haze delivers the perfect energizing lift with just enough smooth relaxation to keep you balanced and motivated.
